page.overview:
Who is Bruno Brega?

Bruno Brega was an handsome rogue sailor from the Tilean city-state of Miragliano.

In his career, Brega had travelled to nearly every port of the Old World. He had seen the great statues of all the old emperors in Altdorf's Königplatz. He'd sailed his ship beneath Marienburg's high bridge and passed within view of the craggy coasts of the fabled and dreaded Norsca. Or at least this is what he tells others. To some people he's just the former leader of a petty band of smugglers that usually operate moving black lotus on the Upper Reik, when he's not sneaking grain past the emperor's excisemen in Altdorf.

Brega has stolen the heart of a prostitute of the Purple Kitten in Miragliano, thanks to his rakish charm, aided in no small way by the gold and jewels he had lavished upon her and by the promise that he will take her away from the bordello when he amassed enough wealth to provide her with a home in whatever city she chose. Sadly, she met her end before that could happen, killed by Krogh, a mutant bounty hunter who murdered her so that he might learn the location of Brega's hideout.

Brega had tried to cheat his former companion, a man called Sollima, who he had saved from being hung in Tobaro. But Sollima and Nuccio, another member of the band, managed to track Brega into the marshlands of Miragliano.
